app.name: veilauth
welcome.tagline: Your two-factor codes, encrypted on this device before they are synced. Not even the server can read them.
welcome.zeroKnowledge: Your master password never leaves this device. If you lose it and your recovery key, nobody can restore your codes.
signup.title: Create your account
signup.tooWeak: Choose a stronger password: at least {min} characters that are hard to guess.
signup.warningBody: Your vault is encrypted with your master password. Next you will get a recovery key. If you lose both, your codes are gone for good.
signup.understand: I understand that nobody can recover my data without my password or recovery key.
strength.empty: Use a long passphrase you don't use anywhere else.
recovery.title: Save your recovery key
recovery.explain: These 24 words are the only way back in if you forget your master password. Write them down or print them, and keep them somewhere safe and offline. They are shown only once.
recovery.savedIt: I have saved my recovery key somewhere safe.
recovery.fileHeader: veilauth recovery key for {email}. Keep this secret.
confirm.title: Confirm your recovery key
confirm.explain: Type the requested words from your recovery key to show you saved it.
confirm.wrongWords: Those words don't match your recovery key.
login.title: Log in
unlock.title: Unlock your vault
notice.signedOut: You have been logged out of this browser.
notice.sessionEnded: Your session ended, for example because the password was changed on another device. Log in again.
notice.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been logged out.
notice.accountDeleted: Your account and all its data have been deleted.
vault.title: Codes
vault.empty: No codes yet. Add your first one with Add.
vault.copied: Code for {name} copied. The clipboard is cleared in 30 seconds.
vault.unreadable: {count} item(s) could not be decrypted and are hidden. They are kept on the server unchanged.
vault.rollback: The server sent older versions of some codes than this device already had. They were ignored. If this keeps happening, your server may be misbehaving.
vault.conflicts: {count} token(s) were edited on two devices at once. Both versions were kept; look for "(conflicted copy)".
sync.offline: Offline. Changes are saved on this device and sync when you're back online.
sync.error: Sync failed. Your changes are kept on this device and will be retried.
update.ready: A new version of veilauth is ready. It is installed the next time you lock.
add.title: Add a code
add.noQr: No QR code found in that image.
add.badImage: That file could not be read as an image.
add.linkLabel: otpauth:// or Google Authenticator export link (one per line)
add.secretHint: The setup key shown next to the QR code (letters A–Z and digits 2–7).
add.skipped: {count} entry(s) in the export could not be read and were skipped.
add.batchProgress: Scanned {received} of {total} export QR codes. Scan the next one.
scan.cameraUnavailable: The camera is not available. Allow camera access, or add the code from an image instead.
edit.title: Edit code
edit.trashBody: The code stays in the trash for 30 days, then it is deleted for good. Make sure you can still sign in to the service.
trash.title: Trash
trash.explain: Codes in the trash are deleted for good after 30 days.
settings.title: Settings
settings.lockHint: The vault also locks when you close or reload the tab, 30 seconds after you switch away, and with Ctrl+L (⌘L on Mac).
password.title: Change master password
password.explain: Your codes stay as they are. All other devices are logged out.
delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: This deletes your account and every code in it from the server, on all devices. It cannot be undone.
about.title: About
about.body: veilauth is a zero-knowledge authenticator: your codes are encrypted on your device with a key derived from your master password, and the server only stores ciphertext.
about.verify: Each release publishes the SHA-256 hashes of the web files, so you can check that what your browser runs matches the published build.
turnstile.title: Human verification
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.NETWORK: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
error.BAD_RESPONSE: The server sent an unexpected response.
error.BAD_REQUEST: The request was rejected. Check what you entered.
error.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That is too large to save.
error.TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Please try again.
error.SESSION_REVOKED: This session was ended. Please log in again.
error.REFRESH_REUSED: This session was ended for safety. Please log in again.
error.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this e-mail already exists.
error.KDF_PARAMS_REJECTED: The server's security settings were rejected by this app.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
error.TURNSTILE_FAILED: The human check failed. Please try again.
error.SYNC_RETRY: The vault changed at the same time. Syncing again.
error.INTERNAL: The server had a problem. Please try again.
error.INVALID_MNEMONIC: That recovery key is not valid.
error.ITEM_TOO_LARGE: This item is too large to save.
error.WORKER_FAILED: The encryption engine stopped. Reload the page.
otp.INVALID_URI: That is not a valid otpauth:// link or QR code.
otp.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This kind of code is not supported.
otp.INVALID_SECRET: The secret key is not valid base32 (A–Z, 2–7).
otp.INVALID_PERIOD: The period must be between 1 and 86400 seconds.
otp.INVALID_COUNTER: The counter must be a whole number of 0 or more.
otp.MIGRATION_DECODE_FAILED: That Google Authenticator export could not be read.
